description: This header file declares utility functions related to fuel injection testing and control, including bench test functions and initialization routines, for the injector central component.

methods.name: fanBench
methods.description: Performs a bench test of the fan.

methods.name: fuelPumpBench
methods.description: Performs a bench test of the fuel pump.

methods.name: milBench
methods.description: Performs a bench test related to the Malfunction Indicator Lamp.

methods.name: initInjectorCentral
methods.description: Initializes the injector central system with a shared logger.

parameters.name: sharedLogger
parameters.description: Pointer to the shared logger instance

methods.name: isRunningBenchTest
methods.description: Checks if a bench test is currently running.

methods.name: runBenchTest
methods.description: Runs a specific bench test identified by subsystem and index.

parameters.name: subsystem
parameters.description: Subsystem identifier for the bench test
